author: SepsisShock
description: Header banners, avatar styling (In Line, Backdrop or Pop Out, with shapes including heart and star, rounded corners, crop focus, fades and fit, and hiding names and pictures), text styling, foreground images, Edit Placement (drag pop-out avatars and foreground images on screen, with Snap to Grid and Undo), Layout (move and resize the chat panel and send bar, put SillyTavern's menu bar on any edge of the screen, set the chat width, message spacing and send box position, and pin blocks from the chat, like a tracker, in boxes of their own that float or dock to an edge, with separate desktop and phone layouts and a Phone Preview), UI Decor (shape, color, opacity and border for the chat panel, messages and send box), Elements (reasoning block styling with button, box, background patterns and typewriter status text, scrollbar colors and custom CSS, custom cursor for normal, pointer, text and click), themes (which also remember which regex folders are on), a Regexes page (SillyTavern's Global, Preset and Character regexes in folders you can switch on and off, reorder, move regexes between, import and export, with a Regex Basics guide), an optional Visual Novel Mode with choices, effects, CG scenes, maps and opening videos, and Reader Mode (read the chat a page at a time, with a page bar and Page Up and Page Down, either Plain or as an open book across the screen with the built-in book or your own picture, page areas, ink colors and font; trackers in Pinned Blocks follow the page), and an Agents page (create and name agents that each do one job you give them, with their own picture, connection, samplers and limits, using your chat's connection, an online API or a local model, without touching SillyTavern's Connection Profiles). Open the menu from the Extensions page, the wand menu (optional) or /ntr.
